newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus cancels combined wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus cancels combined wheat tender.

text.p: The Cyprus Grain Commission on Thursday cancelled a combined 18,000-tonne wheat tender, a statement from the commission said.
The commission did not give any reasons for the cancellation. Last week it issued a tender for a combined shipment of 10,000 tonnes of spring and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat.
"We will inform you in a few days for the new tender invitation," the statement from the commission said.
